data.name: Barimah
data.long_meaning: The name Barimah is derived from the Hebrew language. It is composed of two parts: 'Bari' meaning 'strong' or 'strength' and 'mah' meaning 'son'. Thus, the name Barimah means 'Son of strength'. This name was borne by a Levite in the Old Testament.
